name: DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM
meta_description: Data processing terms, technical security standards, and controller-processor obligations for institutional customers.
title: Data Processing Addendum
description: Standard contractual data processing terms, security safeguards, and subprocessor governance for enterprise workspaces.

paragraphs.text: This Addendum governs the processing of organizational and personal data by LAMID ONE on behalf of enterprise workspace customers.

The customer serves as the Data Controller retaining full ownership and direction over workspace data. LAMID ONE acts as Data Processor, executing computational guidance and operational workflows strictly according to documented customer instructions.
• Scope of Processing: Limited exclusively to executing authorized workspace capabilities, escrow reconciliation, and platform continuity.

LAMID ONE enforces state-of-the-art security controls: tenant-isolated database schemas, role-based access control, cryptographic hashing for sensitive credentials, TLS 1.3 transport security, and automated security vulnerability monitoring.
• Operational Confidentiality: All operational staff with administrative access are bound by strict non-disclosure obligations and background verification.

We maintain vetted enterprise infrastructure partnerships (cloud hosting, database clusters, and regulated payment gateways) under equivalent data protection addenda. Customers are notified prior to the appointment of any new subprocessor.
• Data Transfer Protections: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and regulatory data transfer mechanisms safeguard all cross-border transactions.
